overall_intent: A reference-informed pilot pauses in a parked mecha; repair legibility of owner-relative hand contacts and human/machine support in a coherent photograph.

object_structure.reason: The mechanical subject needs tangible bounded components and connections.
object_structure.expressive_goal: Make the machine feel assembled and weight bearing while supporting the human pause.
owner_relations: machine owns its chassis and leg parts
required_constraints: Preserve pilot face and hair reference
Keep specified forearm and map contacts
open_scope: machine non-anatomical geometry and structural connections
object_structure.role_focus: Visible structural assembly of a compact piloted walking machine, its bounded cockpit parts and continuous load-bearing leg joints.
object_structure.scene_context: A seated pilot pauses over a paper map in an open-front cockpit, with both machine ground supports visible.

grounds.quote: A mechanical mecha structure with a seated pilot using the supplied face and hair appearance.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: Independent role intent follows the frozen scene and owner boundaries before candidate access.

open_scope: visual separation and relative subject scale
